_comment: Pinned versions for the external validation environment. Read by run_powertost.R (which refuses to run against a different PowerTOST) and by harness.py (which records declared alongside observed). An oracle whose version drifts is not an oracle.
_two_tiers: ENFORCED entries stop the build if unmet: their version can change a number. RECORDED entries are resolved by the snapshot and reported into the results JSON, so the report captures what actually ran. Pinning a transitive patch bump that cannot affect a result creates noise rather than confidence, and is a check somebody eventually relaxes for the wrong reason.

recorded._source: Taken from the .environment.r_packages_resolved block of a green CI run, not declared by hand. R normalises CRAN's 1.5-7 to 1.5.7; both forms name the same version, which is why the pin is compared as a version rather than as a string.

r_install_dependencies: c("Depends", "Imports") — NOT TRUE. See install_r_packages.R: TRUE also installs Suggests, which is what broke the first build.

verification_status.state: GREEN — built and run in CI, PowerTOST 1.5-7 resolved as pinned

history.what: docker build failed after 3m24s in install_r_packages.R
history.why: install.packages(..., dependencies = TRUE) also installs Suggests. PowerTOST suggests emmeans, whose chain reaches s2, which needs Abseil C++ and cmake. Nothing in run_powertost.R uses any of it.
history.fix: dependencies = c("Depends", "Imports"), and only the two directly-used packages installed by name.
history.note: The build failing here is the harness behaving correctly: warn = 2 turned the install warning into an error rather than letting a half-installed environment through, and the report step then refused to invent a report.

history.what: docker build failed after 1m27s, immediately after PowerTOST installed successfully
history.why: the pin was compared as a string. CRAN writes 1.5-7; R's package_version normalises the separator to 1.5.7, so as.character(packageVersion(...)) never equals the requested form. The check rejected the exact version it asked for.
history.fix: compare through package_version() on both sides, in install_r_packages.R and in run_powertost.R's lockfile check. Correct rather than lenient: 1.5-7 and 1.5.7 match, 1.5.8 still does not.
history.note: Dropping Suggests took the build from 3m24s to 1m27s and confirmed the snapshot date resolves the pinned version.

history.what: green in 3m30s; 18 comparisons ran, 18 passed, 0 skipped
history.note: Tier 3 PASSED for standard_abe, fda_hvd_rsabe and fda_nti. One FINDING recorded - see detail.

verification_status.detail: The image builds, PowerTOST 1.5-7 installs and matches the pin, and all 18 comparisons ran. Tier 3 is PASSED for all three methods. One comparison is flagged as a FINDING: RSABE-002-BOUNDARY-NEAR/p_be_sabec agreed within tolerance at 4.61 standard errors, which sampling error does not explain. See the README.
verification_status.what_would_change_this: Nothing further for the build. The open item is the RSABE boundary-near finding, and replacing `recorded` with the versions the container resolved, taken from the `.environment.r_packages_resolved` block of powertost_results.json.
